items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: But the three men, between Joe and Sweets and Jimmy Forrest, that’s where the egos clashed on the front line.

ctx.x: Mickey Roker. That’s right. And they had it locked down. But the three men, between Joe and Sweets and Jimmy Forrest, that’s where the egos clashed on the front line.
Because didn’t Joe join — Sweets had a band, didn’t he? Or am I incorrect?
